design_philosophy: E1 Anti-AI Slop Blueprint: Cinematic Cyber-Industrial Command Console (Plancia di Comando Olografica) for Enterprise Bakeries. Zero generic cards, zero standard Bootstrap buttons, zero purple/violet anywhere. Strict industrial color harmony anchored by Deep Void Obsidian (#030712 / #070A10), Cold Rolled Steel (#1E293B / #334155), Fluorescent Laser Cyan (#00F0FF), Warm Fermentation Amber (#FFB800), and Pure Telemetry White (#FFFFFF). Single continuous vertical-scroll console architecture with 3 integrated zones: Master Governance, Mohamed Floor Operators, and BakoMix AI Presence. Everything is styled with tactile glassmorphism, corner-bracket HUD geometry, subtle noise/scanlines, ambient telemetry glows, and hands-free voice resonance.

rules: CRITICAL: NO PURPLE OR VIOLET ANYWHERE IN THE APP (User explicit veto).
Backgrounds must remain near-black void (#030712 / #070A10). Never use full-screen light gradients or pure #000000 flat black without steel tinting.

Color is strictly functional: Cyan (#00F0FF) = Active telemetry, AI state, primary actions; Amber (#FFB800) = Fermentation buffers, secondary warnings, heat indicators; Green (#00FF66) = Scales verified, batch ready; Red (#FF2E4D) = Emergency stop, non-compliance, fault.

typography.pairing_strategy: The 'Cyber-Industrial Command' Archetype: Orbitron/Rajdhani for high-tension uppercase headers + JetBrains Mono for exact numerical data telemetry + Manrope for readable body copy + Vazirmatn for Persian/Arabic text.
rules: BANNED: Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for main titles or HUD headings.
Headings > 28px MUST use tight letter spacing (tracking-wider or tracking-widest) and uppercase rendering.
All numeric measurements (kg, °C, % humidity, timers, PIN keys) MUST be formatted in JetBrains Mono with fluorescent cyan or amber coloring.

motion_and_keyframes.lenis_scroll: Lenis smooth scroll momentum enabled for buttery navigation across zones
motion_and_keyframes.bako_orb_pulse: @keyframes bakoPulse { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.8; } 50% { transform: scale(1.08); opacity: 1; } }
motion_and_keyframes.micro_interactions: All interactive elements utilize 150ms-300ms transition-all duration with active:scale-[0.98] tactile feedback. No layout shifts.
motion_and_keyframes.tablet_performance: GPU hardware accelerated transforms (translate3d, opacity) to ensure smooth 60fps performance on field tablets (iPad/Capacitor PWA).

accessibility_and_testing.apca_contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for standard labels, 7:1 for critical safety alarms and telemetry data.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_requirement: MANDATORY: Every interactive button, input field, modal trigger, PIN key, tab chip, and status beacon MUST include a kebab-case data-testid attribute.
accessibility_and_testing.rtl_multilingual_support: Full RTL support for Persian (FA) and Arabic (AR) using Vazirmatn font-family, direction: rtl, while keeping numeric telemetry values strictly LTR.
accessibility_and_testing.soundless_mode: Strictly NO UI audio sound effects per requirements. All state changes are visual and tactile.

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply this design blueprint across the application by defining shared CSS variables and utility classes in index.css and App.css.
Maintain the continuous single-page vertical scroll command console layout with zero traditional dropdown menus.
Keep all existing functionality, 3D vanilla Three.js digital twin, voice assistant, and PIN security gate working intact.
Eliminate any purple/violet tones across components, substituting with Cyan (#00F0FF), Amber (#FFB800), Steel (#1E293B / #475569), and Void Obsidian (#030712 / #070A10).
Ensure every interactive control contains a descriptive kebab-case data-testid attribute.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_slop_rule: Avoid generic white/grey card design, centered light backgrounds, or Inter font titles. Always implement dark cyber-industrial command console styling with cyan scanlines, corner brackets, and JetBrains Mono numerical telemetry.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_rule: MUST include data-testid on all buttons, forms, chips, keypad buttons, and interactive cards.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_rule: Ensure contrast ratio meets APCA standards for high visibility on workshop/bakery tablets.
